test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left) D # Y * C $ O A T U @ I & E % N F P % & L # Z (Right)

How many such symbols are there which are immediately preceded and immediately followed by a vowel?
solution:
In the given series, there are only two symbols which are immediately preceded and immediately followed by a vowel:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f56fa508d88f1a8e423881af7f7f0f28338ccd37563bfefbee4a75ae427e0cf1.png] 

**The 2 symbols are @ and &.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 3)**
